title: Tiago Splitter
wikitext:
'''Tiago Splitter''' (born [[January 1]], [[1985]] in [[Blumenau]], [[Brazil]]) is a Brazilian-[[Spanish people|Spanish]] professional [[basketball]] player who currently plays in the [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|ACB]] with [[Saski Baskonia|TAU Cerámica]]. The 6'11" (2.11 m) [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] was expected to declare for the [[2006 NBA Draft]], but due to his expensive buyout, which discouraged teams with high picks, he will play next season in Spain. Because of his age, he will be in the [[2007 NBA Draft]], where he will likely be a first round pick, though concern over his buyout is still looming. He has dual Brazilian and Spanish citizenship.
